name: Ben Thanh Market
description: Cho Ben Thanh la diem tham quan trung tam quen thuoc cua Thanh pho Ho Chi Minh.
ttsScript: Ban dang den Cho Ben Thanh, mot bieu tuong lau doi cua Sai Gon.

name: Saigon Opera House
description: Nha hat Thanh pho la cong trinh kien truc Phap noi bat va thuong duoc dung lam diem hen du lich.
ttsScript: Day la Nha hat Thanh pho, mot cong trinh kien truc co dien noi bat giua trung tam quan 1.

name: Tao Dan Park
description: Cong vien Tao Dan la khong gian xanh lon phu hop cho di bo, nghi ngoi va nghe thuyet minh theo dia diem.
ttsScript: Ban dang o Cong vien Tao Dan, mot khoang xanh yen tinh giua khu vuc trung tam.
